# HarnessDock v0.2.0

HarnessDock v0.2.0 promotes the Stable Electron desktop client as the supported Windows, macOS, and Linux release path.

## Highlights

- Stable Electron host lifecycle and runtime orchestration improvements.
- Transactional runtime activation with health verification and rollback recovery.
- Hardened file transfer redirects, workspace path boundaries, OAuth pending-state expiry, and network/proxy recovery.
- Improved tray runtime/network/update state and in-place runtime restart behavior.
- Perry preview and Perry-based experimental mobile host paths removed from the v0.2.0 release surface.
- Repository-owned workspace package versions aligned to 0.2.0.

## Release scope

The official v0.2.0 release publishes HarnessDock desktop artifacts for Windows, macOS, and Linux through the existing release workflow. VS Code/Cursor support remains in the repository but Perry-based preview/mobile artifacts are not part of this release.
